description.narrative: Northern Corridor Transport Observatory is a monitoring tool that measures more than 30 indicators on the performance along the Northern Corridor. The Observatory trucks the indicators using raw data collected from the stakeholders in all the member states. Information provides clear picture on various indicators, enabling one to identify the bottlenecks that needs to be resolved to improve on the efficiency and sequentially improve trade and operations along the corridor
